name: Kara Ahmed Pasha Mosque
scope: The standing mosque and its attached rectangular courtyard and madrasa wings in Topkapı, including the domed prayer hall, minaret, entry portico and fountain.
era: Standing mosque, using measured 1912 architectural controls

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla rendering of the 1912 plan and scaled section. The scale bar, dome profile and tiered windows determine major dimensions and heights.

review.method: Exact local historical plate and institutional public-domain record.
review.notes: The exact local drawing matches the Wikimedia native image. The current Commons record has a corrected historical term notice and links to the primary MIT Libraries public-domain release. Modern attribution-required photos were excluded.
